Method of Attack: Targeting vulnerabilities in devices to take control for distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks
Exploiting known security flaws to execute shell scripts that download botnet clients matching device architecture
Bypassing encrypted string table initialization for stealth and speed
Manual exploitation of vulnerabilities by operators (no brute forcing of telnet/SSH credentials)
Discoverer: Unit 42 researchers of Palo Alto Networks
Impacted Systems: TP-Link devices (including TP-Link Archer A21 AX1800 WiFi router)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of at least 22 known vulnerabilities in connected products
Downloading and executing shell scripts from external resources
